release_notes:
Helix Launcher 1.1.18

  • Added per-daughter SeedVolumes.csv files to the individual dght_ folders during GWL export, alongside the global SeedVolumes.csv file. QC compounds will now correctly map directly to their respective qc_plates.json concentration values, applying a precise transfer ratio calculation for the test plate starting concentration, and automatically enforcing the strict 3.16 dilution factor exactly as requested.
